structuredContent.body:
## Why
C210 established an engine-neutral semantic sidecar and constrained source edit. The next gate was measured reception in one installed Blender build. C211 now exposes a concrete preservation limit, so this prototype is held for an explicit precision/loss decision.

## Changes and exact source
Nine additive files provide the opt-in Blender receiver, versioned finite contract, fixed input/build manifests and 27 CPU controls. Existing compiler, Agent, GLB writer, prior receivers and frozen schedules are unchanged.
Published held head: `cdae8b582a37e37f76f142f07039ba74cedc08ad`, tree `2b2254ae2787a183fda0883fac39b91d2934f9f2`.
Actual attempt used local candidate `66f1940c4c99f52dfdea835445cdc380498815f7`; its nine source files equal independently reviewed worker `fda92dab2fc184b7d90f27b6ca292217efcd07a8`.
The held tip also contains an unexecuted denoising correction from worker `61eb6e9ad425047f73a48c7e3861752768e3ae4a`.

## Observed result: failed/partial
One actual GLB import completed and retained raw observations. No second import or native reopen occurred.
- All 7,800 triangle positions/winding and all 126 sampled world poses passed independent comparison; PBR values passed.
- Split-normal precision failed on 7,088 triangle instances across eight sphere objects. Maximum component error is about 0.0001531541 against the unchanged 0.000002 limit.
- Rendering separately failed because the installed build lacks OpenImageDenoise. The committed correction disables denoising but has not executed and cannot resolve normal preservation.
- The stock importer preserved all 18 object extras as recursively equal dictionaries in this observed build; complete sidecar semantics were separately mapped as JSON metadata. No executable physics is claimed.

## Checks and disposition
All 302 affected methods (275 existing + 27 new) passed without failure/error/skip. Fresh source proof passed 54 checks and reproduced the exact accepted after-artifact/source/sidecar bytes. Khronos checked two GLBs with zero errors/warnings; Three.js passed 252 pose comparisons. The broader mandatory driver was interrupted when the concrete receiving blocker was established; retain its observed failures/unrun methods and all historical failed regressions.

**Do not merge or rerun automatically.** This draft retains reviewable source for issue #154. Main will record the failed experiment and release integration ownership without importing this prototype. The next bounded task must explain the native normal encoding/loss and adopt or reject an explicit contract decision before another receiving attempt. Frozen tolerances and failed evidence must not be rewritten. Second destination and direct-authoring comparison remain later stages.
